metric_notes.winner_accuracy: share of games where projected straight-up winner matched actual winner
metric_notes.margin_mae: mean absolute error of projected home margin versus actual home margin
metric_notes.margin_bias: mean projected home margin minus actual home margin; positive means model favored home side too much
metric_notes.total_mae: mean absolute error of projected total versus actual total
metric_notes.total_bias: mean projected total minus actual total; positive means model projected too many points
metric_notes.score_mae: mean absolute team-score error across home and away scores
